dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit irregular, crenulated perimeters with a high-contrast transition from dark interior to fragmented white exterior. The perimeter edges of the three most central dorsal rings show a sharp gradient boundary between the dark fur and the bright patterned rings.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of merged white pixel clusters is localized on the anterior dorsal and lower lateral regions, where individual rings coalesce into solid high-intensity blobs lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest mid-dorsal 'O' rings form an obtuse scalene triangle, while a secondary cluster of four smaller annuli on the lateral flank forms an elongated irregular quadrilateral.
